description: DICOM modality codes permitted on UPS Reporting Worklist Items and Radiology Reports. Restricts the modality picker to the subset of DCM modality codes relevant to diagnostic imaging workflows.
name: UPS Modality

description: DICOM scheduling priority codes used to assign urgency to Unified Procedure Steps. Restricts the priority picker to the four standard DICOM priority levels.
name: UPS Scheduling Priority

description: SNOMED CT anatomic region codes used to qualify the body region in UPS scheduled procedure steps. Restricts the body-region picker to the anatomical sites encountered in routine diagnostic radiology.
name: UPS Anatomic Region
